crons.name: clickup-pull
crons.prompt: Run: cortextos bus clickup-pull   — this pulls due dates and priorities Jennifer set by hand in ClickUp back onto the local tasks, so the fleet sees her edits. Report ONLY if something changed or it failed; if it updated 0 items, stay silent and do not message anyone.
crons.description: Pull Jennifer's manual ClickUp edits (due dates, priorities) back into the local task store
